# Gate manifest (#218, #216, #229): every function the lichen_api headers and the apps' peer headers declare, with
# the capability that guards it and the thread it may be called from. Format: function<TAB>capability<TAB>thread<TAB>
# header. Generated by `tools/check_layers.sh --gen-manifest`, checked against the headers on every build (#220).
# capability: from tools/layers.conf (cap-func, cap-header; '-' = none, A|B = either); rule D checks an app's use.
# thread: any, lvgl (LVGL task only), not-lvgl, unspecified (the header comment does not say; fix the comment,
# then the entry).
